# guardium-data-protection_rook_ceph_cluster (Resource)

Installs and manages Rook-Ceph distributed storage on Kubernetes clusters. Supports both K3S and OpenShift platforms.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_name` (String) Name of the Kubernetes cluster
- `platform` (String) Target platform: 'k3s' or 'openshift'
- `target_node` (String) Target node hostname for SSH operations (primary master for K3S, API node for OpenShift)

### Optional

- `airgap_install` (Boolean) Use airgap installation
- `airgap_rook_ceph_installation_path` (String) Rook-Ceph airgap installation yaml root directory
- `delete_timeout` (String) Timeout for the delete operation (e.g. '2h', '90m'). Default: 2h.
- `disable_local_path` (Boolean) Disable local-path storage in K3S (only applies to K3S platform)
- `pod_wait_timeout` (String) Timeout for waiting on pod readiness (e.g., 600s)
- `rook_ceph_version` (String) Rook-Ceph version to install (e.g., v1.15.4)
- `set_as_default_storage` (Boolean) Set rook-cephfs as the default storage class
- `sleep_between_steps` (Number) Sleep time in seconds between installation steps
- `taint_masters` (Boolean) Whether master nodes are tainted (not schedulable for regular workloads). When true with worker_count=1, sets CSI provisioner replicas to 1 to avoid anti-affinity scheduling failures.
- `worker_count` (Number) Number of worker nodes. For K3S: 0-1 = test cluster, 2+ = production. Not used for OpenShift.

### Read-Only

- `block_storage_class` (String) Name of the RBD block storage class
- `cephfs_storage_class` (String) Name of the CephFS storage class
- `cluster_type` (String) Cluster type: 'test' or 'production' (K3S only)
- `id` (String) Resource identifier
- `last_updated` (String) Timestamp of last update
- `namespace` (String) Kubernetes namespace where Rook-Ceph is installed
